275402148.description:
Mixed Geological Specimen Lot
Amethyst, Pumice, Granite, and River Stones
29 Items, Mixed Vintage
This diverse collection of geological specimens offers a variety of rock types and minerals, perfect for beginning collectors or educators. The lot includes igneous, metamorphic, and sedimentary samples showcasing different natural textures and formation processes found in nature.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Amethyst Cluster
- Natural purple quartz crystals on a white stone matrix
2.
Volcanic Rocks
- Multiple pieces of porous black and brown pumice and scoria
3.
Granite Specimens
- Multi-mineral crystalline rocks showing feldspar and mica
4.
River Stones
- Various water-worn smooth pebbles in earth tones
5.
Fossil Fragment
- Large textured brown specimen with potential grain or fossil structure
6.
Buckeye Seed
- Single organic horse chestnut/buckeye seed
7.
Sedimentary Rocks
- Sandstone and layered rock fragments
8.
Mixed Mineral Specimens
- Assorted quartz, basalt, and field stones
Condition:
Good natural condition. Most specimens are raw and unpolished, exhibiting natural fractures and textures. The amethyst cluster points appear intact. The buckeye seed is dry and solid. No artificial treatments or coatings are visible on the stones.
